candidates.document_or_record: Severe storms trigger orange alerts across Mediterranean Spain
candidates.relevant_excerpt_or_data: AEMET spokesperson Rubén del Campo said the orange alerts are staggered: Catalonia remains under warning until 13:59, the Balearic Islands from midday, Comunidad Valenciana and Murcia from 14:00, and Almería from 16:00.

candidates.document_or_record: Popular Spanish holiday hotspots hit with 'significant danger' weather alerts today
candidates.relevant_excerpt_or_data: On Wednesday, September 9, AEMET has issued alerts for a whopping six different weather phenomenon [...] Storm warnings are also in place across parts of Andalusia, Catalonia, Murcia and Valencia.
candidates.note: Confirma el aviso en Murcia, no la hora exacta de entrada en vigor.

candidates.document_or_record: Severe storms trigger orange alerts across Mediterranean Spain
candidates.relevant_excerpt_or_data: On the northern coast of Alicante, rainfall could reach up to 60 liters per square meter in 12 hours and 40 liters per square meter in just one hour [...] In Murcia, despite the storm risk, maximum temperatures could still reach 37°C.
candidates.note: La cifra de lluvia (40L/60L) se atribuye textualmente a la costa de Alicante, no a Murcia. Solo el dato de calor (37°C) está confirmado para Murcia.

candidates.document_or_record: Murcia cools off after overnight rain and sudden temperature drop
candidates.relevant_excerpt_or_data: On September 9, several areas of Murcia were under yellow and orange weather alerts due to heavy rain and storms, with local downpours reaching up to 30 litres per square metre in an hour.
candidates.note: Dato real posterior (30L/m²/h) inferior al previsto (40L/m²/h) en el claim.

candidates.document_or_record: Murcia cools off after overnight rain and sudden temperature drop
candidates.relevant_excerpt_or_data: According to the Agencia Estatal de Meteorología (AEMET), any rain will be limited to the early hours, and while there is still a chance of storms, they are not expected to cause problems. [...] the worst storms have mostly missed the area.
candidates.note: Fuente posterior indica que no se materializó el riesgo de inundación descrito en el claim.
